fileSkill-clip.label: Clip
fileSkill-clip.tip:
Clip area of icon
$Related command
Load Image

fileSkill-inherit.label: Inherit
fileSkill-inherit.tip:
Inherits specified skill's attributes, events, and scripts
If the same attribute exists, it overrides the inherited skill's attribute value
If the same type of event exists, it overrides the inherited skill's event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command
However, inherited scripts will stack instead of being overridden

fileSkill-attributes.label: Attributes
fileSkill-attributes.tip:
Initial attribute list
$Optional types
Boolean, Number, String, Enumeration(String)
$Related commands
Set Boolean, Set Number, Set String

fileSkill-events.label: Events
fileSkill-events.tip:
A list of skill events
Events stop executing when the actor is inactive or destroyed
Access "Skill Caster" to get the actor with this skill
Access "Event Trigger Actor" to get the actor with this skill
Access "Event Trigger Skill" to get this skill
$Optional types
Cast Skill: Triggered by the "Cast Skill" command
Add Skill: Triggered when an actor adds this skill
Remove Skill: Triggered when an actor removes this skill
Custom: Triggered by the "Call Event" command

fileSkill-scripts.label: Scripts
fileSkill-scripts.tip: Add script files to extend this skill
